auth.title: Authentication smoke
auth.why: Verify that login flows are reachable and credentials are accepted before running broader suites.

smoke.title: Core smoke
smoke.why: Run a minimal health-check pack for fast validation on any environment.

homepage.title: Homepage interactions
homepage.why: Verify sorting and resource type filters work correctly on the homepage grid.

maps.title: Maps CRUD
maps.why: Verify that an admin can create and delete a map end-to-end.

map-permissions.title: Map permissions
map-permissions.why: Verify view and edit permissions on maps for groups, IP ranges, standard users and anonymous visitors, and unadvertised maps.

ldap.title: LDAP authentication
ldap.why: Verify that a standard LDAP user can authenticate when LDAP profile is enabled.

geoserver.title: GeoServer catalog integration
geoserver.why: Verify that a layer can be added to a map from the catalog when GeoServer profile is enabled.

catalog.title: Catalog services
catalog.why: Verify WFS and CSW catalog searches on the local GeoServer.

map-toc.title: Map table of contents
map-toc.why: Verify layer visibility, settings, attribute table, removal and filtering in the map viewer.

map-tools.title: Map tools
map-tools.why: Verify zoom controls, zoom to layer extent, projection readout and persistence of viewer changes.

map-services.title: Map backgrounds, search and 3D
map-services.why: Verify the background selector, place search and the 3D viewer on services of the local GeoServer.

print.title: Printing
print.why: Verify that a map with a GeoServer layer is printed to PDF by the printing module.

dashboard.title: Dashboards
dashboard.why: Verify dashboard creation, text widgets and data widgets built on the local GeoServer layer.

geostory.title: GeoStories
geostory.why: Verify geostory creation, edit mode and section authoring.

context.title: Application contexts
context.why: Verify the context creator wizard, opening a created context and removing it.

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.why: Verify the user manager lists accounts and that a created user can authenticate.

url-params.title: Opening MapStore from a link
url-params.why: Verify that the map view passed in the URL or posted by an external page through setParams is applied.

dashboard-views.title: Dashboard views
dashboard-views.why: Verify the layout views of a dashboard: naming, adding, ordering, removal and read only display.

resource-permissions.title: Dashboard and story permissions
resource-permissions.why: Verify view, edit and IP range permissions of dashboards and geostories, and the tools of their viewers.

map-share.title: Map sharing
map-share.why: Verify direct links, embed code, permalinks and 3D sharing of maps, with layers and identify on the shared map.

resource-share.title: Dashboard and story sharing
resource-share.why: Verify direct links, embed code and permalinks of dashboards and geostories, and the scroll position of a shared story.

context-resources.title: Application context resources
context-resources.why: Verify permissions, editing, import and export of application contexts and the maps that depend on them.

context-share.title: Context sharing
context-share.why: Verify direct links and embed code of application contexts, with their layers and identify.

context-plugins.title: Context plugins
context-plugins.why: Verify plugins enabled in application contexts: burger menu, brand navbar, map catalog, save as rules and camera position.

context-templates.title: Context map templates
context-templates.why: Verify that a map template offered by a context replaces its map.

annotations.title: Annotations
annotations.why: Verify drawing, editing, identifying and removing map annotations.

measure.title: Measure
measure.why: Verify length, area and bearing measures, their units, export, conversion to layer and annotation, and 3D measures.

import-export.title: Map import and export
import-export.why: Verify map export in MapStore and WMC formats and the import of maps, annotations and vector files.

map-details.title: Map details
map-details.why: Verify writing, editing, removing and showing at startup the details of maps, also within a context.

map-views.title: Map views
map-views.why: Verify adding, playing and editing the map views of a 3D map.

search-bar.title: Search bar
search-bar.why: Verify coordinate, map CRS and bookmark searches and custom WFS search services.

identify.title: Identify
identify.why: Verify feature info on WMS, WFS and imported layers, hidden groups, HTML responses, highlight and hover popups.

backgrounds.title: Backgrounds
backgrounds.why: Verify adding WMS backgrounds with title and thumbnail, removing them, and the catalog default service afterwards.

interoperability.title: Interoperability
interoperability.why: Verify layer metadata from the capabilities, WMS 1.1.1 requests in 3D and graticule layers.

attribute-table.title: Attribute table
attribute-table.why: Verify browsing, filtering and WFS-T editing of layers in the attribute table, including non spatial ones.

export-data.title: Export data
export-data.why: Verify exporting WFS layers, also cropped to the viewport, and imported vector layers as GeoJSON.

layer-settings.title: Layer settings
layer-settings.why: Verify the display options, fields, description and identify templates of a layer.

toc-settings.title: Table of contents settings
toc-settings.why: Verify the settings and context menus of the table of contents, swipe, reordering and editing permissions.

filter-layer.title: Filter layer
filter-layer.why: Verify attribute, time and cross layer filters of a layer, with aliases, applied to the map and saved with it.

legend.title: Legend
legend.why: Verify the legends of the table of contents, interactive and filtered by the view, and the floating legend.

timeline.title: Timeline
timeline.why: Verify the timeline of time enabled layers: playback, ranges, settings, viewport filter and identify in time.

map-widgets.title: Widgets on map
map-widgets.why: Verify counters, charts, tables and filters built as widgets on the map.

filter-widgets.title: Filter widgets
filter-widgets.why: Verify filter selector widgets on the map: values, targets, forced and empty selection.

dashboard-connections.title: Dashboard widget connections
dashboard-connections.why: Verify widgets of a dashboard connected to a map widget, and a map connected to a table.

dashboard-map-widgets.title: Dashboard map widgets
dashboard-map-widgets.why: Verify map widgets of dashboards: identify, table of contents, empty maps, legend, background and the advanced editor.
